description: File Format Acquisition System — Claude Code project configuration. PHASE 0 CONSERVATIVE MODE.
phase_note: Phase 0 ONLY. Broad Write permissions for src/python/**/*, src/net/**, src/python/open-source/**, src/dotnet/open-source/**, src/dotnet/commercial/**, samples/by-format/**, schemas/neutral-model/**, prototypes/by-format/**, reports/security/**, reports/legal/**, acquisition-packs/<format-id>/**, Phase 1+ LLM tool scripts, spec-cache implementation scripts, and network download commands are DENIED. Phase 1 permissions are activated after human review and Phase 0 sign-off. See AGENTS.md Section N for the full list of Phase 0 forbidden files. Format-first layout: src/python/{format}/ and src/net/{format}/ are Phase 4+ targets (also denied in Phase 0).
notes: PHASE 0 CONSERVATIVE MODE: Only Phase 0 file paths are in the allow list.

New format-first source layout (run011): src/python/{format}/ and src/net/{format}/ are the Phase 4+ targets. Old paths src/python/open-source/, src/dotnet/open-source/, src/dotnet/commercial/ are OBSOLETE and must not be created.

Phase 1+ paths (src/python/**/*, src/net/**, src/python/open-source/**, src/dotnet/open-source/**, src/dotnet/commercial/**, samples/by-format/, schemas/neutral-model/, prototypes/by-format/, tests/fixtures|oracle|fuzz/, reports/security|legal/, LLM client scripts, spec-cache implementation scripts, project commands) are explicitly denied.
Network download commands (curl, wget, Invoke-WebRequest, iwr, python *acquire_spec*) are denied in Phase 0.
Spec-cache implementation scripts (acquire_spec.py, refresh_check.py, spec_index.py) are denied in Phase 0; created in Phase 1 via TC-0007.

NOTE: powershell *Invoke-WebRequest* and Bash(iwr *) patterns are approximated via separate curl/wget/Invoke-WebRequest/iwr entries. If the settings schema does not enforce these patterns at the shell level, the restriction is documented in AGENTS.md Section T and docs/specification-cache.md.
